title: ModelConfig
description: Configurations that are loaded on initialization of the model.

device.description: Device to run on. When omitted, the best device compiled into the build is used (CUDA or Metal if enabled, otherwise CPU).

Device.description:
A enum of supported devices to run models on

Turning this into a runtime device is the job of the `djinn-models` crate.

ModelArchitecture.description:
The variant of the model to be loaded.

`qwen2_5_instruct` is Qwen2.5-Instruct in quantized GGUF form: an instruct model with native tool calling. The size (0.5B, 1.5B, ...) is chosen by the `repo_id` / `weights_file` in the model source.

(Variants are deliberately not documented one by one: a doc comment on a variant makes the generated schema a `oneOf`, whose validation errors no longer list the valid names.)

ModelSource.description: Where to load the model from, either HuggingFaceHub or from the file system

repo_id.title: repository id
repo_id.description: Hub repository holding the weights. Defaults to the architecture's standard repository.

tokenizer_repo.title: repository id
tokenizer_repo.description: Hub repository to take `tokenizer.json` from, when it is not in `repo_id` (GGUF repositories usually do not ship a usable tokenizer).

weights_file.title: weights file
weights_file.description: File to download from the repository (for GGUF models). Defaults to the architecture's standard file.
